inj.note: Banks was able to play in Week 9 after the Saints activated him from injured reserve, but his ankle still seems to be bothering him ahead of Sunday's game versus the Panthers. If he can't upgrade to a full practice Friday, he may get stuck with an injury designation going into the weekend.

news.h: Saints activate WR Jordyn Tyson, LT Kelvin Banks, cut RB Kendre Miller
news.d: Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. have been activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns.
